name: tricep-tiger-tail
instructions:
1. While in a seated position, position one end of the tiger tail on a solid surface and hold the other end in one hand.
2. Adjust pressure into tricep by using your bodyweight to bear down on the roller.
3. Slowly roll up and down the length of the tricep for 20-30 seconds.
4. Repeat on the other side.
